review: Integrated the published 2026-11-01 nightly, not the moving main branch. Reconciled 26 conflict files across rendering, EventLoopCtl/splitscreen wrappers, keyboard focus, native content hooks, sandboxed hmod runtime and account session recovery. Preserved Android system DNS, IME/SAF/DocumentsProvider, launcher-selected graphics, lifecycle return, optional worker/cache limits and fixed opt-in mod bundle. GLES terrain packs all current varying fields and lowers colored-light nested arrays without changing uniform bytes; Vulkan now additionally adapts the reviewed opaque/cutout terrain optimization, with ordering guards and shader/LOD/culling fallbacks; the merged upstream baseline is unchanged. Kept deployment workflows disabled. ARM64 Clippy, optimized ARM64/ARMv7 builds and targeted input/content/account/GPU tests passed. Tablet Vulkan Compatibility world, inventory, Home/resume, launcher return and provider root were exercised. Final F-03L GLES retest is recorded in docs/android-0.7.7-testing.md; other ABIs and final release APKs still need validation. No blanket resolution of low-end crashes or performance reports is claimed.
